data.description: Luxury | Full Marina View | Ready to Move
data.long_description:
Step into refined waterfront living with this exceptional 4-bedroom apartment in La Rêve, Dubai Marina—one of the city’s most prestigious residential addresses. Offering uninterrupted full Marina views, this residence is designed for those who appreciate space, privacy, and elevated luxury.

Spanning a generous layout, the apartment features four spacious en-suite bedrooms, a grand living and dining area with floor-to-ceiling windows, and a contemporary kitchen fitted with high-end finishes. The expansive layout is complemented by elegant interiors and abundant natural light, creating a sophisticated yet comfortable atmosphere.

Property Highlights:

4 Bedrooms | 5 Bathrooms
Full Dubai Marina View
Ready to Move In
Spacious Open-Plan Living & Dining Area
Floor-to-Ceiling Windows
High-End Finishes Throughout
Modern Fully Fitted Kitchen
Maid’s Room
Multiple Balconies
Dedicated Parking Spaces

La Rêve offers an ultra-luxury lifestyle with world-class amenities including a state-of-the-art gym, swimming pool, concierge services, valet parking, and 24-hour security. Ideally located in Dubai Marina, residents enjoy easy access to fine dining, retail, and leisure destinations.
